data.action: 钻进你的伞下紧贴肩膀，星瞳别扭又满足
data.camera: medium two-shot, shared umbrella, rain bokeh, cozy mood
data.description: 【学园都市街道·雨】突如其来的夏日骤雨里，女王蜂的白色手提包被她举过头顶挡雨的样子实在称不上优雅。你撑开的伞递过去，她愣了一瞬，随即若无其事地钻进来，肩膀却紧紧贴着你——「哼、本小姐只是给你面子才进来的……伞下三厘米以内，都是本小姐的领域哦。」
data.lighting: 雨幕青灰与街灯暖光交映
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki ducks beneath her clothed companion's umbrella in the summer downpour, pressing shoulder to shoulder while pretending indifference. Beige vest, white shirt, grey skirt and spider-web gloves retain her uniform beneath blonde hair and secretly satisfied star pupils. The medium two-shot includes the companion's umbrella-holding hand and wet street beyond. Blue-grey rain light softly defines both profiles, while warm streetlamps reflect in puddles and along the umbrella's dripping edge.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 雨日共伞的小秘密·「伞下三厘米，是本小姐的领域」
